§3§lPurpose and mechanism§r
This task checks for the Cycle Overlimit Chip §2without consuming it§r; completion provides §116§r extra Critical Steam Entangled Singularities. The chip is used for the Mega Steam Turbine Array's cycle-overlimit feature. Read the chip and array information for conditions and risks. This task does not check installation or operation.

§3§lPreparation and operation§r
Store the rewarded critical singularities securely; it does not establish safe operation after chip installation. Before use, consult both turbine and chip documentation, then check combined dynamo capacity and electrical destinations against the conditions allowed by the current configuration.
